definitions.explanation: A focused section or edition of a magazine, newspaper, or television program dedicated to a particular topic. Also used as a verb with する to mean producing such a feature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特集|とくしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧だ。
examples.english: This month's special feature is about dieting.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{特集|とくしゅう}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They were running a special feature on famous cherry blossom spots on TV.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧{特集|とくしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧、⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたく→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After reading that magazine's travel special, I wanted to go to Okinawa.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in media contexts. Used as a noun ({特集|とくしゅう}⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧ — special feature article) or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ({特集|とくしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to feature, to run a special on). Japanese magazines frequently run themed {特集|とくしゅう} issues, and news programs use the word for in-depth segments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特集|とくしゅう}⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧: feature article
- {特集|とくしゅう}{番組|ばんぐみ}: special feature program
- {特集|とくしゅう}{号|ごう}: special issue (of a magazine)
- {特集|とくしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to put together a special feature
